decision: REJECT adoption for now; leave production ocean source unchanged
limitations: Configured SwiftShader raw128-square fixture, not complete ocean/scene GPU time.
Synthetic/data-texture inputs mix footprints differently from spatially coherent real sea pixels; branch divergence is not representative and was not separately measured.
Driver query medians were substantially slower with the guard; wall medians are very small/noisy and means also worsened. No performance gain is demonstrated.
Correct numeric equality is insufficient reason to integrate a performance-only change with no observed benefit.
nextAction: None. No production patch, rerun or broader benchmark; root explicitly closed this decision.
